risk_note: RV2 (content page preview; contract planned removal). Admin issues a preview token for a page version (AdminOperationGuard content.page without step-up, ContentAdminModule on the admin entry): token = 32 random bytes base64url, only its sha256 stored, created_at / expire_at from one injected Clock reading 600 000 ms apart, token row and audit (page_preview_token_issue, no token or hash) in one transaction. GET /v1/pages/{page_key}/preview (api entry) validates token hash, page_key, X-App-Id and expire_at > now in one atomic UPDATE that bumps used_count and returns the version; any failure is the same 30701; sections returned as stored, no audience filter, no cache (P7, E4). Request logs record route templates only, so the token never reaches them (E3). Both operations leave planned (mechanical). The rule-test kit's app ids were mechanically shortened to the 32-character X-App-Id limit by the orchestrator before the implementation (assertions unchanged). No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
